'''Creed''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. At some point, he ended up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] where he began learning [[Ta-Ree]] spells from a [[Yapi]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]]. Creed learned spells including [[block pain]] and [[boost attribute]].<ref name="E" /> Creed was also hired by [[Themog]], a criminal on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]], to kill newly deputized [[Police officer/Legends|Protectors]].<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Creed was an example character used in ''[[Endgame]]'' to teach players how the learning of [[Ta-Ree]] spells worked.
